description_en: Queries the protection pause status of a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-pause-protection-status --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePauseProtectionStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

PauseStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether WAF protection is paused for the instance. Valid values:

0 (default): Protection is not paused.

1: Protection is paused
PauseStatus.description_zh:
暂停防护状态。

0（默认）：表示未暂停防护。
1：表示已暂停防护
